LESSON: REPAIRING GARMENTS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.1: Repairing Garments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Repairing Garments
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Repairing Garments
2. give Kenyan examples of Repairing Garments
3. practise a safe skill for Repairing Garments

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Repairing Garments

Teach
• Observe Repairing Garments in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Repairing Garments (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Repairing Garments.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Repairing Garments.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Repairing Garments.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Repairing Garments.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Repairing Garments: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Repairing Garments with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
